title: Anyone else running on autopilot today?
why: 今天是日常线，且这是你的第一篇日常材料；上一篇技术短文理解100%说明基础不错，所以用中等偏易的闲聊帖子练习，顺便复现本周正在学的几个生词。
focus: 读的时候留意主语+动词的完整结构，以及assume、rely on、specify、redundant这几个词在日常语境里的用法。
text:
Hi everyone! I just want to share how my day went.

I woke up late today, so I had to rush. I always rely on my alarm, but today it didn't ring. I think I forgot to set it last night.

At work, my manager asked me to write a report. She didn't specify a deadline, so I assumed I had until Friday. I hope that's right!

After lunch, I cleaned out my desk. I found an old notebook from my first job. It felt useless now, like a redundant tool I never use. I threw it away.

In the evening, I went for a walk with my neighbor. We talked about our weekend plans. She wants to try a new coffee shop downtown. I said yes right away — I love trying new places!

Now I'm home, relaxing on the couch. My cat is sleeping next to me. It's a simple day, but a good one.

How was your day? Did anything funny or annoying happen? I'd love to hear your stories!

questions.q: Why was the person late this morning?
questions.a: 因为闹钟没响，她忘记设置闹钟了。

questions.q: What did the person do with the old notebook, and why?
questions.a: 因为觉得这本旧笔记本像多余没用的东西，就把它扔掉了。

questions.q: What does the neighbor want to do this weekend?
questions.a: 她想去市中心尝试一家新开的咖啡店。
